intro.title: The kinds of systems we build.
intro.description: Three demo projects we built, showing how we approach architecture, delivery, and outcomes. They illustrate our capabilities and are not client case studies.

items.title: Oivaly: Nordic Maker Marketplace
items.description: A multi-vendor marketplace that connects shoppers directly with independent Nordic makers, with verified sellers, transparent fees, and protected payments.

gallery.caption: Storefront with search and featured makers
Curated collections for browsing by theme
Seller onboarding with business identity checks
Buyer protection and payment safeguards, explained step by step

items.overview: Oivaly is a demo marketplace we designed and built to show how a multi-vendor platform can work for craft businesses. Shoppers browse departments, search, save favourites, and check out from many independent studios in one cart, while makers apply to open a verified shop and manage their own listings.
items.challenge: Independent makers have little reach on their own, and the large retail platforms that could give them reach also take a big share of every sale. Shoppers, meanwhile, cannot easily tell who really made a product, where it comes from, or whether their payment is safe. Good craft stays hard to find, and buying it feels risky.
approach: A storefront with departments, search, wishlist, and a cart that works across many sellers
Seller onboarding that checks a studio's official business identity before its shop goes live
A clear, published fee model so most of each sale stays with the maker
Buyer protection that holds payment until delivery is confirmed, with a simple path to resolve problems
Published material and packaging standards, so buyers can see how products are made and shipped
outcomes: Makers reach buyers and keep more of each sale
Shoppers can see who made what and where it comes from
Purchases feel safe, with protected payments and clear returns

items.title: STSL: Bulk SMS Campaign Platform
items.description: A bulk SMS platform where businesses organize audiences, send reviewed campaigns from approved templates, and track delivery, results, and spend in one place.

gallery.caption: Campaign list with review status, delivery, and cost
Prepaid wallet, auto-recharge, and billing history

items.overview: STSL is a demo platform we designed and built for sending bulk SMS campaigns. Teams organize contacts into segments, write messages from approved templates, submit campaigns for review, and follow delivery and click results. A prepaid wallet with auto-recharge keeps spending visible and under control.
items.challenge: Sending messages to thousands of people is easy to get wrong. Contact lists end up scattered across spreadsheets, campaigns go out without a second pair of eyes, and nobody can easily see what was delivered, what it cost, or how much balance is left. The result is wasted spend, messages that break platform rules, and audiences that receive the wrong message.
approach: Audience segments that group contacts so each campaign reaches the right people
Reusable message templates with an approval status, so only checked wording is used
A review step for campaigns, with a clear reason when a message is rejected
A campaign list showing status, delivery, clicks, and cost at a glance
A prepaid wallet with auto-recharge and a transaction history
outcomes: Fewer mistakes before a message is sent
One clear view of delivery, results, and spend
Predictable spending, with no surprise bills

items.title: Doctor Portfolio: Specialist Practice Website
items.description: A professional portfolio site for a medical specialist that presents credentials, services, and focus areas clearly, and lets patients request an appointment online.

gallery.caption: Home page introducing the specialist and the practice
Services grouped into clear care areas
Focus areas patients can explore one by one
Appointment request form with clinic details and emergency guidance

items.overview: This demo is a portfolio website for a fictional cardiologist, designed and built by us. It introduces the doctor and the practice, groups services into clear care areas, lets visitors explore each focus area, tells the career story through a timeline and patient stories, and ends with an appointment request form and clinic details.
items.challenge: Independent doctors and specialists are often found through a hospital listing or an out-of-date page. Patients struggle to see who the doctor is, which conditions they treat, what experience they have, and how to book. Many end up phoning around, and clear guidance for urgent situations is easy to miss.
approach: A home page that quickly shows who the doctor is and what they offer
Services grouped into clear care areas, each with a call to action
Interactive focus areas so patients can explore the conditions they care about
A career timeline and patient stories that build trust without clutter
An appointment request form with clinic hours, contact details, and visible emergency guidance
outcomes: Patients understand quickly who they would be seeing
Appointment requests arrive in a structured form
